common_contract.inputs: Finite nonempty rectangular <=100000rows,1024columns,1Mcells. Baskets strictly0/1 with <=32columns; no frequency weights,missing rows,automatic text extraction.
common_contract.rules: Apriori includes all frequent sets up to max_rule_size2..6,max antecedents1..5,min support1e-12..1,confidence0..1,lift>=0. Defaults .1,.4,1.2,3,4. Rule output limit1..100000 default10000; exceeding it errors rather than truncates. <=1Mjoins,100Mtransaction count work,100kfrequent sets,1Mrule candidates; may reject large dense supported input by explicit work limit. No global rule ranking/top-k truncation. Every rule proper disjoint nonempty LHS/RHS. Counts exact; row number denominator includes empty baskets.
common_contract.rule_metrics: support=count(X union Y)/n;confidence=countXY/countX;lift=n*countXY/(countX*countY);leverage=support-pX*pY;conviction=(1-pY)/(1-confidence). Confidence1 yields convictionnull with conviction_infinite=true when pY<1; if pY1,indeterminate null/false. All thresholds inclusive.
common_contract.reliability: Complete-case respondents x items,>=2rows,2..64items,abs<=1e150,n*p^2<=100M. Raw alpha=p/(p-1)*(1-sum var(item)/var(total)). Standardized uses correlation-scale items and requires every variance positive. Deleted alpha null when fewer than2items remain or variance zero. Corrected correlation excludes the item from total. Undefined/nonrepresentable JSONnull; negative alpha is retained. No automatic reversal,significance interval,IRT,unidimensionality/validity conclusion.
common_contract.verification: 7 public tests GREEN,independent NumPy/exhaustive exported-CABI gate recorded separately; nativeSQL pending.
